offering_description.value: SPX Technologies designs and manufactures heating, cooling and ventilation equipment for commercial and industrial facilities and homes. It also makes utility locating, inspection, communications and navigation equipment for utilities, contractors and public agencies. It sells through distributors and direct sales teams and provides field service for cooling systems.

primary_products.value: Cooling towers and evaporative cooling equipment; boilers, water heaters and electric heaters; air handling equipment and dampers; underground utility locators and pipe inspection cameras; radio monitoring equipment and navigation and obstruction lights

primary_services.value: Cooling tower inspection and maintenance; cooling tower repair and reconstruction

customer_segment.value: B2B: HVAC contractors, building owners, industrial plant operators, utilities and underground infrastructure contractors; B2G: Municipal utilities, transportation authorities, defense agencies and public safety agencies

end_markets.value: Commercial and institutional buildings; residential heating; industrial process cooling; utility and municipal infrastructure; transportation and defense

revenue_model.value: product sales: Heating and cooling equipment, detection instruments, lighting systems and replacement parts; project or contract: Custom cooling systems and cooling tower reconstruction; service fees: Cooling tower inspections, maintenance and repairs
revenue_model.category: product sales; project or contract; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Turns purchased components into HVAC and detection equipment for contractors, facility operators, utilities and agencies; service provider: Inspects, maintains and rebuilds installed cooling towers for facility owners and plant operators

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific, with sales in other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: Heating, cooling and ventilation, utility locating and inspection, radio monitoring, navigation and obstruction lighting

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving industrial customers, utilities and public agencies; distributors / dealers: HVAC wholesalers and specialty equipment distributors; agents / brokers: Independent manufacturers’ representatives serving HVAC contractors and engineers
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: HVAC efficiency and equipment safety standards, FCC rules for radio equipment and FAA standards for obstruction lighting
